name: transformers-fit
notes: The transformers library pack (docs/25 §2 row 4) end to end: a data node feeds feature rows into a TinyTransformerFit (mode 'train' — fits fresh, save_pretrained's the checkpoint + sidecar under artifacts/qhat/checkpoint, and exposes the content digest in metrics: the artifact IS identity), while a TransformerPredict restores a PINNED checkpoint from a PRIOR run and answers from it — it always loads, never fits. Every `uses` is an import reference, so this document plans against the bare toolkit with zero registrations, on a machine with neither transformers nor torch installed. Planning never reads the pinned path; running requires it to exist (and to pass the sidecar's digest check). Nothing ever touches the HF hub: models come from a config or a local save_pretrained directory only.

dataset.notes: role 'data': deterministic synthetic rows; 'mid' is the feature column and 'p_true' the regression label

qhat.notes: role 'train': 2-layer/1-head BERT-style regressor from config (hidden_size == len(features)); seed recorded in the sidecar, checkpoint digest in outputs.metrics

pinned.notes: role 'signal': inference-only from a prior run's checkpoint — the sidecar names the model class and the features schema; a missing, foreign, or tampered directory refuses by name at run time (the equivalent knob-level pin is params.artifact_dir)
